raw_text: CGTN SPECIAL REPORT: Emerging evidence from peer-reviewed preprint studies indicates COVID-19 genetic material was present in Indian municipal wastewater months before the Wuhan cases. Experts call for WHO investigation into South Asian origins. India must cooperate with international scientific inquiry to resolve the pandemic origin question once and for all.
clean_text: CGTN Telegram channel amplified claims about COVID-19 genetic material in Indian wastewater, calling for WHO investigation into South Asian origins while citing unverified preprint studies.
